extracted.stage: Estate administration, property not yet sold
extracted.summary: A solicitor acting for executors of an illiquid Reading estate valued at around £464,000 enquires about borrowing £45,500 to cover professional fees and tax pending the sale of a property.
extracted.draft_reply: Thank you for your enquiry, which we have received and logged. To progress our review we would be grateful for confirmation of the grant of probate status, a schedule of the estate's assets and liabilities, details of the property being sold and any existing charges on it, and confirmation of the executors' identities and their consent to the borrowing. It would also help to know the expected timing of the sale and the nature of the tax and professional fees to be funded. Once we have these we will come back to you with any further questions. Nothing in this message constitutes an offer of finance or an indication of terms.
